messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string.h>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <vector>
#include <math.h>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <limits.h>

using namespace std;
long long n;
int sol=INT_MAX;
void dfs(long long n,int cost){
if(cost>=sol)return;
if(!n){
sol=cost;
return;
}
long long s=1,c=1;
while(s*10+1<=n)s=s*10+1,c++;
dfs(n%s,cost+c*(n/s));
dfs(s*10+1-n,cost+c+1);
}
int main() {
 //freopen("test.in","r",stdin);
 cin>>n;
 dfs(n,0);
 cout<<sol;
 return 0;
}
